Here is a concise algorithm of how to start learning Lojban.

Duplicate resources were removed to make it shorter and thus more effective.
{| class="wikitable" style="width: 350px;"
|-style="vertical-align:top;"
|style="width: 50%;"| <center>Start reading<br/>[[The Crash Course (a draft)|"The Crash Course"]]<br/>[[File:CC-01.svg|100px|link=[The Crash Course (a draft)]]</center> || <center><span class="plainlinks">After reading first sections of Chapter 1 you may read<br/>[[File:slaide.png|100px|link=https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1Yrxt9gAtqA_oSDD76Toq8VLSZjjOxJ5rkKsxFs3Cw8E/pub?start=true&loop=false&delayms=5000]]<br/>[https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1Yrxt9gAtqA_oSDD76Toq8VLSZjjOxJ5rkKsxFs3Cw8E/pub?start=true&loop=false&delayms=5000 Lojban in simple phrases].<br/>once in a while.<br/>Also available in [http://mw.lojban.org/images/d/d1/Lojban._How_to_quickly_create_sentences.pdf PDF].</span></center>
|- style="vertical-align:middle;"
|colspan="2"|<center>Use whenever you like:</center>
|-style="vertical-align:top;"
| <center><span class="plainlinks">search the [https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/jb/index.html#sisku/coi dictionary]<br/>[[Image:la_sutysisku.png|100px|link=https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/jb/index.html#sisku/coi]]<br/>for the Crash Course.</span></center>|| <center><span class="plainlinks">search the [https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/en/index.html#sisku/pluka live dictionary]<br/>[[Image:la_jbovlaste.png|100px|link=https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/en/index.html#sisku/pluka]]<br/>which has more words although they are added by live speakers and may not always be proofread.</span></center>
|-style="vertical-align:top;"
| <center><span class="plainlinks">try searching for arbitrary words in [https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/muplis/index.html#sisku/pluka the database of sentences]<br/>[[Image:La Muplis.png|150px|link=https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/muplis/index.html#sisku/pluka]]<br/>Some of the sentences are not proofread by fluent speakers of Lojban.</span></center>|| <center><span class="plainlinks">Join [https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/irci/ the chat]<br/>[[Image:lo-se-irci.svg|100px|link=https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/irci/]]<br/> and try talking to other Lojbanists when they appear there. Try asking them questions.</span></center>

# You may read parts of it when you like and return to it whenver you like. No need to consume the whole introudction at once. Consider it an alternative introduction for another point of view.
